server {
    listen 8080;
    server_name localhost;
    root /var/www/html;
    index index.html 404.html;

    location / {
        rate_limiting on;
        rate_limit 10 per second per IP;

        log_format json {
            $time_local "$request_method" "$status" "$http_user_agent"
        }

        access_log /var/log/nginx/benchmark-access.log json;
    }
}
